title: ExtensionManifestAuditorOutput
description: Audit result for a Chrome Extension manifest.json file.

manifest_version.description: The value of the manifest_version field in the parsed manifest. 0 if absent.

is_mv3_compliant.description: True only when manifest_version === 3 AND no MV2-only deprecated fields are present.

security_warnings.description: List of security risk warnings. Empty array when no security issues are found.

optimization_suggestions.description: List of actionable fix recommendations in imperative mood. Empty array when no issues found.

oneOf.title: ParseError
oneOf.description: Returned when the input string is not valid JSON.

error.description: Human-readable parse error message, e.g. 'Invalid JSON: Unexpected token } at position 42'.
